classification: Existing EXT-D-0217 symptom is a plausible origin for this retained refusal, but the dev560 read-only run does not establish when or under which auth state this row was written. No new defect ID should be allocated from this observation.
inference_and_limits: A signed-in header now does not mean the saved refusal was produced while signed in. The card reads durable state and has no automatic refresh of lastRefusal on authentication change.
A fresh authenticated membership permission defect remains possible if a new Save/Retry under a verified bearer reproduces the refusal. This run neither triggered nor observed such a request.

The current source fix addresses the known stale-profile guest path, but an unchanged older refusal can still be displayed on current main. This is not evidence that dev560 or current main failed a fresh Save/Retry.
